description.value:
You create a network of mind-controlling mycotoxins directly in targets' brains, attempting to seize command and force them to obey you. The first target must attempt a Will save. If it doesn't critically succeed, another target within 30 feet of the first attempts a Will save; if that target doesn't critically succeed, another target within 30 feet of it attempts a Will save, and so on. You can choose to end the spread at any point, and you can't target the same creature more than once. Once the spell has taken effect, you can only focus on one member of the network to control at a time. You can change the target of your focus by Sustaining the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, and your network can spread no farther.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your spores.

Failure The target joins your mycorrhizal network. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Controlled] condition but can act normally unless it's the focus of your control. If it's the focus, it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the target drops out of the network, and your focus automatically shifts to the closest remaining member of the network.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.
